name: Constraint Satisfiability Isomorphism
description: Replaces explicit descriptions of relaxed scheduling scenarios (which directly exposed the additive lower bounds) with an inquiry into the satisfiability of subsets of formal interval constraints. Models must now mathematically deduce that packing disjoint intervals implies a sum-of-lengths bound, and that sequential intervals imply a sum-of-lengths bound, rather than just pattern-matching the English text for operations.
